text: Pooja is having her knee operation on 14 November. She's quite nervous about the general anaesthetic. She asked lots of questions at the pre-op appointment last week and still isn't convinced. Her sister is staying with her for the first few days, then her husband takes over. Remind me to text her the night before, and maybe drop round some magazines once she's home.
Jada and Tunde are expecting their second baby in March 2027. Their eldest, Esther, already wants to be called the big sister.
Housewarming at Laila's new flat on the 3rd of December. Bring wine, she doesn't drink beer.
Ruby's mum had a fall last week and is still in hospital. Ruby is going in every evening after work and sounds exhausted.
Ali mentioned he's been learning to make sourdough. Apparently his starter is called Doughvid.
Zeynep's christening for little Mia is on 9 May 2027 at St Mary's. I need to find out what a godparent is expected to bring.
Ethan had his gallbladder out on Monday. Home now, sore but cheerful. Must call him at the weekend to see how he's getting on.

Dinner at Manon and Rafael's on Saturday 7th of November, 7.30. Manon is vegetarian and Rafael is allergic to nuts, so no pesto. They've invited Connor and his partner too, and I think Laila might come if her shift finishes in time. Rafael said it's partly to celebrate Manon's new job, but she doesn't want a fuss made about it.
Aiko told me she's pregnant! Due in late April. She hasn't had the twelve-week scan yet.
Need to buy a birthday card for Mia's dad. His seventieth is 21/11 and she's organising a surprise lunch.
Aurelio's leaving do was supposed to be on Friday but it's been cancelled because half the team have flu.

Tadhg is recovering from his hernia repair. He's not allowed to lift anything for six weeks, which is driving him mad because he can't take the dog out. Connor has been walking her, bless him. Tadhg's follow-up with the consultant is on 26 November, and if all is well he can go back to work in early December. He's already bored of daytime television.
Picked up the prescription and booked my own dentist appointment for 2 December. Still need to sort the car insurance renewal.
Bruno and Marisol had their baby girl on 12 October! Her name is Lucy, 7lb 2oz. Don't forget to send them a card and something small for the baby.
Kemal said Oliver is in hospital again with his chest. He was admitted on Sunday and they're keeping him in until at least Thursday.

Svetlana is throwing a fortieth for her husband, Graham, on 28 November 2026. It's a surprise, so not a word to him. She asked if I could bring dessert, and I said I'd do the trifle. The party is at the cricket club from eight. Graham thinks they're just going for a quiet dinner with his brother, so I need to make sure I don't mention it when I see him at football on the 21st.

Yasmin's sister Sadia is getting married next summer, probably July 2027. Yasmin is a bridesmaid and already stressed about the hen do, which she's organising. It's pencilled in for the second weekend of May. Sadia wants a spa weekend, but their cousins want Lisbon. Yasmin says she'll be broke by the end of it.
Anan collects vintage film cameras. He's been after a Pentax K1000 for ages, which might be a good birthday present.
Kai's MRI is on 4th November. He's been having headaches for months and is worried about what they'll find. I should check in with him afterwards.
Eva and Mustafa invited us to their anniversary party on 15 January. Ten years married. They said no gifts, but I might get them a nice bottle of something anyway.
Salma just started maternity leave. The baby is due on 30 November and she's been told she might need a C-section.
Esther's cat Biscuit had to have a tooth removed at the vet yesterday. Esther was more upset than the cat.

Lucy Hughes has asked me to her son's first birthday party on 22nd of November. Ask her what he's into at the moment. It's at a soft play place in town from two until four, and she said siblings are welcome. Her husband's parents are flying in from Kraków for it, so it's a big deal for them.

Graham's hip replacement went well. Svetlana says he's already walking with a frame and should be home by the weekend. He was in for five nights in the end because his blood pressure dropped after the operation. Svetlana has taken a fortnight off work to look after him. I should send a get-well card this week.
Reminder: drop off the casserole at Pooja's on Thursday. Her surgery is the day before and she won't feel like cooking.
Jada's mum, Mrs Williams, is having cataract surgery on 17/12. Jada is taking her and staying over for a couple of nights.
Book train tickets for the 19th. Also cancel the gym membership before the end of the month.
Laila's baby shower was lovely. She's due on 2 February 2027 and they've decided not to find out whether it's a boy or a girl. Her partner Kai wants to paint the nursery yellow, she wants green.
Ali is having his wisdom teeth out on Friday 6th November. He asked if I could drive him home afterwards, and I said yes.
Zeynep is struggling a bit since the baby was born. Not sleeping, and her husband is back at work already. I need to pop round with food this week and give her a break for an hour or two.
Ethan's Christmas drinks are on 12 December at the Crown. He's also invited his brother Tadhg, who I haven't seen since university.
Manon has started a pottery course on Tuesday evenings. She loves it and says she wants a wheel of her own one day.
Rafael's dad passed away last month after a long illness. The funeral was in Porto. Rafael is back now but seems quiet. I should ask him for a coffee soon.
Aiko's twenty-week scan is on 14 December. She and her husband Ali are hoping to find out the sex.
Mia is hosting Friendsgiving on 26 November. Everyone brings a dish. I've signed up for the roast potatoes.
Aurelio is in Ireland visiting his grandmother in hospital. She had a stroke on the 3rd. He's not sure when he'll be back.
Tadhg and his girlfriend Ruby are getting engaged! He's proposing on her birthday, 8 March 2027, and has sworn me to secrecy. He wants help choosing the ring.

Connor's wife is pregnant with twins. They found out at the scan on Wednesday. He looked equally thrilled and terrified. They're due in May 2027, though twins usually come early. His wife has had awful morning sickness, and they're already wondering whether they need a bigger car. Must remember to ask him about the next scan.
Bruno said Marisol's recovery from the C-section has been slower than expected. Her mum has flown over from Bogotá to help for a month. Remind me to message Marisol next week, not just Bruno.
Kemal hates surprise parties, so don't let anyone plan one for his fiftieth.
Oliver is out of hospital! Discharged this morning. He has to go back for a follow-up appointment on 10 November.
Svetlana's daughter Eva is having her tonsils out on 23rd of October. She's six and very brave about it, apparently, but Svetlana isn't.
Yasmin invited me to her Diwali party on 8 November. Bring sweets or flowers, not alcohol.
Anan's wife, Dr Nakamura, is a paediatric surgeon at the Royal. Useful to know.

Long call with Sadia tonight. She's finally booked her IVF consultation for 5 January 2027 after nearly two years of trying. She's hopeful but trying not to get too excited. Her husband Mustafa is very supportive, though she says he worries more than she does. I want to send her something nice the week before, maybe a book and some good tea, nothing baby-related.
Eva's housewarming is on Saturday. The new place is in Clifton, near the suspension bridge. She mentioned she still hasn't got any plants, so a big monstera might go down well.
Salma had the baby! A boy called Oliver, born 28/11 at 3am. Both doing well. Must get a gift before visiting.
Tunde's knee surgery has been postponed again, now to February 2027. He's fed up because he can't play five-a-side until it's done.
Esther and her husband are hosting Christmas dinner this year for the first time. Twelve people. She's slightly panicking. I'll offer to bring the starters and help set up on the 24th.
Lucy said her brother Sam is coming out of hospital on Tuesday after his appendix burst. He'll stay with their parents for a while.
Note to self: my blood test results should be back by 30 October. Ring the surgery if I haven't heard by then.
Pooja's husband, Kemal Popescu, runs a small bakery on Gloucester Road. Their daughter is three and obsessed with dinosaurs.
Jada said the christening is now on 14 March 2027 instead of February, because the vicar was double-booked. Lunch afterwards at her parents' house.
Ruby's birthday drinks on 30th of November have been called off. She's had to fly home because her grandad is very poorly.
Rafael and Aiko both mentioned the reunion dinner in June 2027. Rafael is organising it and wants a headcount by the end of January.
Ethan's girlfriend Manon had her scan this afternoon and everything looked fine. Ethan was clearly relieved. He said she'd been really anxious about it.
Mustafa said his son Kai is having grommets put in on 2 December. It's a day case, but he's only four and they're worried about the anaesthetic. Text Mustafa that afternoon to see how it went.
Graham's retirement party is on 18 December, but I'm away that weekend. I need to tell him before Friday and maybe take him for lunch in the new year instead.
Groceries, post office, then pick up the dry cleaning before it closes at five.

Caught up with Marisol at the school gate. She's back at work three days a week from 1 November, and Lucy starts at nursery the same week. She seems tired but happy. Her mum flies back to Colombia on the 5th. I'll ask how the first week went next time I see her.
